name: Yasser Elsaid
milestone_by_age_26: Founded Chatbase.co in February 2023 at age 21 and grew it to $64K MRR ($768K ARR) within six months as a bootstrapped solo founder, entirely during his final year of university.
early_history_summary: Elsaid grew up in Egypt and started studying Computer Engineering at Cairo University (2017-2019) before moving to Canada in 2019 to study Computer Science at York University's Lassonde School of Engineering (2020-2023). He interned at BlackBerry (2021), Tesla (2022), and Meta (2022), but the FAANG lifestyle felt too safe and he pivoted to indie hacking. In November 2022, weeks before ChatGPT launched, he started building Chatbase using the OpenAI API. He launched to 16 Twitter followers in February 2023; the tweet went viral, the first paying customer arrived within 30 minutes, and within six months he reached $64K MRR — failing two university classes in the process.
family_context_summary: Originally from Egypt; moved to Canada in 2019 for university. Family financial status and parents' professions are not documented in reviewed sources.
